name: daalu-assistant
description: In-IDE coding agent powered by your own GPU (or Daalu-hosted). It reads/searches your workspace and proposes changes via native tool-calling — code prompts never leave your perimeter.

commands.title: Daalu Coding Agent: Move Chat to Secondary Side Bar (right)

daalu.gatewayUrl.description: URL of the Daalu inference-gateway. Empty = read from env DAALU_GATEWAY_URL.

daalu.tokenFile.description: Path to the service-token JWT minted by the token-minter sidecar.

daalu.model.description: Override the model requested from the gateway. Empty = use the DAALU_MODEL env the workspace pod injects (the model you picked when creating the workspace). Must match what vLLM advertises.

daalu.toolsEnabled.description: Let the model drive read/search/write/run tools via OpenAI function-calling (requires a tool-calling model, e.g. Qwen2.5-Coder or Qwen3-Coder). When off, the agent is plain chat.

daalu.maxToolIterations.description: Max read-only tool rounds before the agent is forced to give a final answer. Bounds runaway loops and token spend.

daalu.maxReadBytes.description: Byte cap per read_file tool call (the file is truncated past this). The 48 GB-card coders (Qwen2.5-Coder-32B / Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B) carry long context, so this can be larger than the 14B default.

daalu.maxSearchResults.description: Max matches returned by the search_files tool.

daalu.autoOpenRight.description: On startup, best-effort move the chat to the right (secondary side bar). If the VS Code build doesn't support the move it stays in the activity bar; you can also run 'Daalu Coding Agent: Move Chat to Secondary Side Bar' manually.
